item.title: Cooler weather to linger before record-breaking heat arrives this weekend
item.description: Cooler, cloudy and rainy weather will continue through Tuesday with spotty light rain and drizzle, but temperatures will warm up on Wednesday and reach record highs of 80-85 degrees Friday through Sunday.

item.title: Road closures planned in Huntersville for Netflix’s 'The Hunting Wives' filming
item.description: Traffic delays are coming to parts of Huntersville as filming for Netflix’s The Hunting Wives gets underway.

item.title: One injured in NW Charlotte school bus crash
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. (QUEEN CITY NEWS) -- One person was injured in a school bus crash in the Mountain Island area Monday evening. Queen City News observed a Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools bus on Couloak Drive around 6:15 p.m., just off Mount Holly-Huntersville Road. item.title: Rev. Jesse Jackson to lie in state at SC Statehouse
item.description: Memorial services for Reverend Jesse Jackson began Monday morning in South Carolina to honor the Greenville native and civil rights leader.

item.title: 'Finally falling': Iranian Americans in Charlotte react to U.S. airstrikes
item.description: U.S. and Israeli forces launched strategic airstrikes on Iran, killing Iran's supreme leader Ali Khamenei, and sparking hopes of a regime change in the country, with some preferring Maryam Rajavi to lead a provisional government and others advocating for Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi.
